system.description: The priest and their allies within range are gifted with a temporary capacity to speak and understand a foreign language, with a bonus of +3 to each individual’s Skill Value in the Knowledge skill for speaking/understanding. The ability does not allow them to read or write the language, but only communicate vocally. The priest must specify which language they wish to understand before the ability is performed.
